title: MLS vs TSG
summary: Their Druid holds five and yours holds three. Kill their healer or lose the long one — there is no third plan.

sections.title: Their healer is the target, because their DPS are not
sections.body: Counts: Warrior 8, DK 7, Druid 5. The DK's seven include two magic immunities and an MLS is entirely magic, so he is the worst target on the floor for you specifically. The Warrior outlasts any window you own. That leaves the Druid, and your comp has the control to keep him out of a go for longer than either of them can cover for him.

sections.title: Opener — stack the control on one target

steps.note: 30s stun on the Druid. Instant, so nothing is cast first.
As the stun breaks. Fresh category, full duration.
15s. Third category on the same target inside one go.
90s. The slowest term; everything aligns to it.
45s. Half-cadence, so it is in every go.
30s. The filler term between full goes.
40s. On the Warrior, so he cannot reach you.
180s. Break it — it is a channel, not a buff.

sections.title: Your Shaman is the liability
sections.body: He holds three answers to their Druid's five and the Warrior reaches him on a 17s Charge. If the go does not land inside the first two attempts, the matchup inverts and their DK's magic immunities decide the rest of it.
